items.reason: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:118-124 checks the slot end against the override start, allowing a slot that starts before the override and ends inside it. Slots generated from another host's availability can reach this check for every fixed host at slots.ts:483-493, so the missing start-bound check affects returned availability.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:100 makes slotStartTime UTC, but slots.ts:110 formats the adjusted override using server-local dayjs. Overrides originate as UTC-constructed Dates in packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:218-222, so a non-UTC server can produce a different calendar date and incorrectly skip or apply the new override check.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:105-130 rejects a slot when any matching-date override excludes it. Consequently, a 14:00 slot generated from the afternoon range in packages/lib/slots.ts:211-245 is rejected by a separate 09:00–11:00 override, even though it fits a valid range.

The call at packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots.ts:581-586 does omit schedule fields, but fixed hosts already passed the full schedule check at slots.ts:483-499 and loose-host IDs were filtered using their schedules at slots.ts:502-522. This later selected-slot pass only removes surviving users and slots at slots.ts:565-590; it cannot restore availability rejected by those earlier checks.
